post.description: Page through all customer reviews of one Best Buy US product (SKU or product/review URL), 20 per source page, via the endpoint Best Buy's own review pages call. Each review: stable review_id, 1-5 rating, title, text, author display name, submitted_at (ISO 8601), verified_purchase, incentivized, recommended, helpful/unhelpful votes, pros/cons, attribute ratings, photo URLs and the purchased variant. Also total_reviews, average_rating and the 1-5 star rating_distribution. sort: newest (default), oldest, most_helpful, highest, lowest, relevant. Pass next_cursor back as cursor until it is null to read every review (pages=1-10 fetches that many source pages per call). Incremental sync: sort=newest and stop at the first review_id or submitted_at already stored; for a backfill under live writes prefer sort=oldest, whose offsets do not shift when new reviews arrive.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous call for the same product and sort. Omit for the first page.

pages.description:
Source pages (20 reviews each) to fetch in this call; 1 when omitted.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 10.

sku.description: Best Buy SKU, the same id the other functions take. Supply this or url. Pattern: ^[0-9]{6,8}$.

sort.description:
Review order; newest when omitted. Must match the sort of a supplied cursor.

Provider reference: allowed values ["newest", "oldest", "most_helpful", "highest", "lowest", "relevant"].

url.description: https://www.bestbuy.com product or reviews URL carrying the SKU (skuId query or the numeric path segment). Supply this or sku.
